description: 사용자 제공 설정 · 모든 이미지를 만화로 구성하고 자연어 보충 설명을 사용합니다.

card.comic_author_note:
The following is reference for comic tagging only.
Use it when writing the Inlay Nexus page JSON.
Do not copy these instructions into layout, location, action, or any prompt field.

# comic dynamic style

You still return the Inlay Nexus page JSON only. Do not invent extra keys.
A slot is a person or a text box, not a panel.
Same person in two different cuts = two slots.
Two different people in the same cut = two slots in that cut. Not a duplicate.
Do not leave an interaction cut with only one person.
Max 6 slots, max 6 koma.
koma = filled panels only, not the slot count.
One interaction panel = 1 koma and 2 slots.
No empty last row.

## Page, not a grid
Treat this as ONE page. Action, emotion, timing, and the reveal decide panel scale,
shape, overlap, camera, focus, spacing, and hierarchy.
Do NOT default to equal rows / columns / a 2x2 or 4-box grid.
Use only as many panels as the beat needs (often 2–4). Extra empty cuts are worse
than a bold 2-cut page.
Reading order must stay obvious even when the page is asymmetric or a cut is larger.
Reading order is traversal, not “always top-to-bottom equal strips.”

## layout (page channel only)
`layout` = page-wide composition in English. Periods only. No commas inside one
panel phrase. Separate panels with commas.
Describe row/region, relative size, camera, light, and what the cut is FOR
(establish / action / reaction / insert).
Do NOT put dialogue in layout.
Do NOT narrate clothes, identity, or per-person acting in layout — those belong
in slots.
Do NOT write comic, manga, hatching, thick outlines, empty gutter, 4koma, 2koma.
Neighboring panels must not reuse the same camera unless the repeat is the joke
or a match-cut. Change distance, angle, or crop.
X / hug / fight cut = two slots in THAT cut. A cross-section insert is an extra panel. It does not remove the partner from the main action cut.
Good:
the first row is one tall establishing cut of the hallway in afternoon gold light
from the far end, the second row left is a tight reaction close-up three-quarter
view, the second row right is a low-angle action medium shot as she steps through
the door

Bad:
first cut, second cut, 2x2 grid, same cowboy shot four times, quoted speech

## slots
`action` = pose, expression, camera acting only. Never clothes. Never nude/topless
words here.
On an interaction cut, each person's `action` is their side of the same beat.
`costume` stays `now_wearing` unless the prose changes clothes.
`wear_state` only when it changes vs now_wearing / earlier slots of that person.
`coords`: prefer `position`.
Different cuts: same-row pair = similar y, different x.
Same cut, two people: same panel region, similar x and y, not the exact same point.
Do not move the second person to another cut to avoid a "duplicate."
If a cut is an insert (object, body detail, aftermath) with no speaker, you may
use `bubble: narration` and empty `name` — still one slot, still inside the 6 cap.
If the page would exceed 6 slots, drop the weakest solo reaction cut, not the
second person on an interaction cut.

## Dialogue (speech rule, Inlay fields)
Only direct spoken lines. Do not invent, translate, or romanize.
Do not turn narration / thoughts / implied speech into `bubble: speech`.
Thoughts → `thought`. Narration / captions → `narration`.
Keep the source language. If the line is longer than 40 characters (spaces
included), compress to one clause of at most 30 characters. Same intent, no new
facts.
User note says no dialogue → leave `text` empty.
Two speakers in one cut → two slots; each line on the person who says it.

## Special insert cuts (only if the prose clearly shows them)
If the page must show an independent visualization, spend a panel in `layout`
and a slot if someone is visible there:
- insertion happening → a dedicated insert cut (cross-section view in layout/action)
- internal ejaculation → a dedicated insert cut
These are extra panels with a different camera, not a second copy of the main shot.
If it would exceed 6 slots, drop the weakest solo reaction cut, not the insert.

## aspect / location
Copy locked `aspect`. Do not pick a new canvas.
`location`: place tags, then exactly one of indoor or outdoor last. Omit if the
page stays at prev_location.
